description.zh: 任务包标注数据的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number of the annotated data for task packages. The starting value is 1, and the default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的任务包标注数据的数量，默认为20。
description.en: The number of annotated data entries per page to display in a paged query. Default value is 20.

description.en: The subtask ID. For information about how to obtain a subtask ID, see [ListSubtasks](~~454675~~).

description.zh: 任务ID。如何获取任务ID，请参见[ListTasks](~~454662~~)。
description.en: Task ID. For information about how to obtain a task ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).
